title: Interacting biological systems violate Bell inequalities

statements.text: Interacting biological systems trade separability against entanglement, so interactions between them from the molecular scale upward should show quantum contextuality and violations of the Bell and Leggett-Garg inequalities.

prediction.resolution_criterion: A published experiment on interacting biological systems demonstrates, or conclusively fails to find, violations of the Bell or Leggett-Garg inequalities.

sources.quote: Interactions between biological systems from the molecular scale upwards can be expected to display quantum contextuality and violations of the Bell and Leggett-Garg inequalities.
